subject: Pre-demo readiness & engineer availability — Orbit Analytics integration
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orbitanalytics.com>, Ben Porter <bporter@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-demo readiness & suggested windows (Orbit Analytics)

Hi Samira / Ben —

Thanks again for agreeing to take a closer look at Redwood for the Orbit integration. Before the full technical demo we'd like to run a short "pre-demo readiness" call with your engineering and procurement leads so we can: 

- Confirm which model variants you want us to demo (low-latency vs high-throughput)
- Identify any network/IP allowlist requirements and what credentials you'll provide for staging
- Walk through the security questionnaire items that tend to bubble up during procurement

Attached: pre-demo-checklist.pdf and a redacted security questionnaire (see notes).

Suggested 45-min slots next week (Pacific):
- Tue 06/29: 9:00–9:45am PT
- Wed 06/30: 11:30–12:15pm PT
- Thu 07/01: 2:00–2:45pm PT

If none of those work, propose two windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Karthik, Maya — can your SE and infra folks join one of these? If Samira can share the plate of internal attendees, we’ll also loop in procurement.

Next steps: AE confirms slot, SE confirms attendees, customer shares any network constraints.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf, redacted-security-questionnaire.docx

From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orbitanalytics.com>, Ben Porter <bporter@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-demo readiness & suggested windows (Orbit Analytics)

Hi Samira / Ben —

Thanks Aditya — we can cover this. Monica (SE) and I will attend from the engineering side; Karthik will join for the higher-level architecture discussion. Monica's preference is the Wed 06/30 11:30–12:15pm PT slot.

Quick logistics notes / ask for Orbit engineers: 
- If you plan to test with your staging instance, please provide the egress IPs (or CIDR) that our staging will need to be whitelisted for, plus any SSO/Okta test accounts.
- If there are network proxies or mTLS requirements, flag them now so we can prepare a short runbook.

I’ve attached a preliminary SE availability calendar (.ics) and highlighted the Wed slot. If procurement needs a separate 15-min call to align on contract cadence, we can do that immediately after (12:15–12:30pm).

Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: se-availability.ics

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orbitanalytics.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Porter <bporter@orbitanalytics.com>, procurement@orbitanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-demo readiness & suggested windows (Orbit Analytics)

Hi all —

Appreciate the checklist and the quick turnaround. Heads up: procurement is still finalizing our internal PO process and they asked to delay any contract conversation until early next week. We can still do the technical readiness call but will need to move the demo itself to the following week.

Wed 06/30 11:30am PT is OK for our engineers (I’ll be there), but two asks: 
1) Please keep the session focused on integration points and network requirements (no contract pricing talk).
2) Can you share a short one-page network allowlist template we can give to our infra team?

If that Wed time becomes a hard stop because of procurement, I’ll propose alternate times by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
VP, Platform Engineering | Orbit Analytics
samira.khan@orbitanalytics.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orbitanalytics.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-demo readiness & suggested windows (Orbit Analytics)

Thanks Samira — that works. I’ll prep a one-page allowlist template and a short checklist of what we’ll need for an authenticated staging session (keys, SSO test account, expected request volumes). I’ll drop both into the Drive link Aditya included and paste final copies into calendar invite notes.

Two quick technical clarifications for your engineers: 
- We typically test with a 1k–2k req/day traffic sample to validate throughput and cache behavior; if you expect higher burst traffic, let us know so we can mirror it in staging.
- For mTLS, we need a cert chain in PEM; if you can share the certs to a secure transfer link (we recommend an SFTP or your secure SharePoint), we’ll use them for the handshake.

I’ll plan to join Wed and can extend to 60 minutes if the network walk-through needs it.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Great — thanks Samira. Wed 06/30 11:30am PT confirmed for the pre-demo readiness call (45–60m).

Calendar invite sent with Zoom link and a short agenda: intro, integration surface, network allowlist, staging credentials, immediate next steps. I’ve also added procurement to the invite as optional for the 12:15–12:30pm follow-up if they’re able to join.

Action items before Wed: 
- Orbit infra: share egress IPs/CIDR or a call to confirm allowlist (Samira)
- Orbit procurement: confirm whether they can join a brief follow-up (procurement@orbitanalytics.com)
- Redwood SE: Karthik to upload allowlist template and staging checklist to Drive

See you all on Wed — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
